myStories.title: Storytime
myStories.introTitle: Turn a child's drawing into a lasting story
myStories.intro: Upload a child's drawing and AI will create a custom story and a beautiful cover. Edit the text if you like, then record the story in your own voice. After review, it will be published in the app under your name.
myStories.step1: Choose the child's drawing from gallery or camera.
myStories.step2: Review the suggested story text and cover, and edit if needed.
myStories.step3: Record the story in your own voice.
myStories.step4: After approval, the story is published under your name.
myStories.createCtaDesc: Upload a drawing and create a story
myStories.dailyLimit: You can upload a drawing and create an AI story only once per day. Try again tomorrow.
myStories.dailyLimitCtaDesc: Come back tomorrow to upload a new drawing
myStories.empty: No stories yet. Use the button above to begin.

myStories.logoutDesc: You can sign back in anytime

myStories.pickHint: Choose a drawing, then choose the cover before your story begins.
